prompt: I have an Angular 19 app with a password change form. I need to add cross-field validation so that the newPassword and confirmPassword fields must match. The form already has currentPassword, newPassword, and confirmPassword fields in a FormGroup. Show me how to write the cross-field validator, attach it to the FormGroup, and display the mismatch error in the template. Use typed reactive forms.
assertions: Validator attached to FormGroup via validators option
Validator uses control.get() to compare sibling controls
Template checks group-level hasError or form.errors for passwordMismatch
